# ankra_cluster_log_shipping (Resource)

Whether a cluster's container logs are shipped to Ankra's hosted log store. Shipping is opt-in and off by default. The counterpart of `ankra cluster logs-ship enable` and `disable`. Destroying the resource turns shipping off again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_log_shipping" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  enabled    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cluster ships its logs.

### Read-Only

- `agent_supports_switch` (Boolean) Whether the cluster's agent advertised that it follows the switch at its last check-in.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether the hosted log store is live on the platform; while it is not, the switch is stored but nothing ships.
- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_log_shipping.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
